The rest are established Filipino tech loanwords as used in Android/Google Filipino UI (device, app, build, emulator, Dark mode, Airplane mode, Landscape/Portrait, Custom, Offline), iOS UI names that Apple does not localize into Filipino (Control Center, Notification Center, Dock, App switcher, Home button), debugger commands (Step in/out/over), colour marketing names and product names. 4 remaining detector hits: Tomacco · Web inspector, Full screen · web preview, QA environment (*.json), the agent-name list — all names/loan terms.
